sites.name: Prambanan Temple Compounds
sites.what: Hindu temple complex on the Yogyakarta and Central Java border, with Lumbung, Bubrah and Sewu temples on the same ticket (UNESCO World Heritage).

access.tickets: Book on the operator's official ticket site; one ticket covers Prambanan, Lumbung, Bubrah, Sewu and the Prambanan Museum. Foreign adults IDR 400,000 (about AUD 31, RBA rate 30 October 2026), children 3 to 10 IDR 250,000, same price every day (search snapshot).

lore.text: Local legend says Prambanan's thousand temples were raised in a single night for Princess Roro Jonggrang, who was turned to stone for tricking her suitor.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source

laws.rule: Yogyakarta city's Smoke-Free Areas regulation (Perda 2/2017) covers public places, and the city's own news portal says Malioboro has been declared a smoke-free area, where smoking, advertising and selling cigarettes are not allowed. Operators of public places must provide a designated smoking spot, and the city has pointed visitors to those spots. In late 2024 the city's Satpol PP (municipal enforcement) said it was giving spoken and written warnings, mostly to tourists, with criminal penalties not yet the priority.
laws.penalty_signal: Up to one month in custody or a fine of up to IDR 7,500,000 (about A$587, at IDR 12,780 per A$1, the rate implied by the RBA 30 October 2026 figure used in this repo's Rinjani record). Listed in the regulation as a minor offence (pelanggaran).
